title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Genesis 2: the seventh day, the garden in Eden, and the making of the man and the woman.

questions.text: What did God do on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day God finished his work and rested from all his work which he had done.

answers.text: He rested from all his work

questions.text: Why had no herb of the field sprung up yet?
questions.explanation: No herb had sprung up because Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and there was no man to till the ground.

answers.text: God had not caused it to rain

questions.text: What watered the whole surface of the ground?
questions.explanation: A mist went up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

questions.text: From what did Yahweh God form the man?
questions.explanation: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

questions.text: Where did Yahweh God plant the garden?
questions.explanation: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and put the man there.

questions.text: What is the name of the first river, which flows through the land of Havilah?
questions.explanation: The first river is Pishon. It flows through the land of Havilah, where there is good gold.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh God put the man into the garden of Eden?
questions.explanation: Yahweh God put the man into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

answers.text: To build a city in it
To guard it from the serpent

questions.text: What did God say would happen on the day the man ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil?
questions.explanation: God commanded the man not to eat of that tree, for in the day he ate of it he would surely die.

answers.text: He would sleep for many years

questions.text: From what did Yahweh God make the woman?
questions.explanation: God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, took one of his ribs, and made a woman from the rib.

answers.text: A rib taken from the man

questions.text: How does the chapter describe the man and his wife at the end?
questions.explanation: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
